# opnsense_ids_policy_rule (Data Source)

Per-rule adjustments of installed Suricata rules, by signature ID (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Policy ▸ Rule adjustments**). Prefer `opnsense_ids_policy` for more than a few rules. Changes are applied with a rule reload.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the IDS rule adjustment.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action: `alert` or `drop`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `sid` (Number) Signature ID of the rule.
